subject: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners

Team —

Quick checkpoint ahead of the May QBR run: I attached a concise metrics snapshot and a one-page QBR input template. Please review the three signals we flagged in last week's runbook and confirm owners + a short remediation plan by EOD Thursday. High-level items:

- Latency: p50 increased ~22% week-over-week for hosted text-generation in us-west-2. Root suspicion: increased cold starts in the new routing path + a KV-cache invalidation event on Apr 14.
- Cost: embeddings spend jumped ~18% due to larger-than-expected batch sizes from the new retriever job (NimbleRetail pilot).
- Uptime/availability: 99.92% for the month; two short blips (totaling ~12 minutes) in eu-west-1 during the 4/11 outage window — investigating if routing fallback worked as designed.
- Usage: pilot customers (NimbleRetail) drove a 35% usage ramp in the embeddings endpoint — positive, but we need to cap cost/latency impact.

Ask list (please reply inline):
1) Confirm owner for each item (Latency / Cost / Uptime / Pilot usage).
2) If you own remediation, add a one-line mitigation and ETA.
3) Any QBR slides you want me to include — call out in comments.

Attachments: metrics_snapshot_apr2027.xlsx (summary + per-region), latency_dashboard_Q1.pdf (p50/p95 charts), qbr_input_template.docx

I'll consolidate and send to execs on Friday morning.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners

Thanks, Tessa. Quick notes from infra:

- I'll take Latency ownership. Initial read: the KV-cache invalidation on Apr 14 coincides with a config rollout that increased cache TTLs to 0 for a short window. We'll revert the rollout patch and monitor. ETA: fix + monitoring checks in 24 hours.
- For the eu-west-1 blip, logs indicate a transient load-shedding on a set of older instances; we've flagged auto-upgrade exclusions and are patching.

I'll add a one-line mitigation into the QBR template and drop a short slide on the root cause/mitigation.

Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T13:44:00Z
Subject: Re: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners

Looping in ops notes and cost owner confirmation:

- I'll take Cost ownership. Short-term actions: cap embedding batch-size to 256 for the NimbleRetail tenant (applied as a per-tenant guardrail) and add throttling if monthly spend > forecast. ETA: config change today, monitoring alerts tomorrow.
- Laura: can you confirm whether finance wants a postmortem line item for the client billing spike (Daria, cc'd below)?

Also attaching a brief runbook excerpt (pasted in the slide deck) and the quick link to the per-tenant quota controls.

[attachment: per_tenant_quota_controls.txt]

Jonas
Director, Platform Economics
Redwood Inference
From: Daria Petrov <daria@nimble-retail.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@nimble-retail.ai, ops-support@cloudops.io
Date: 2027-04-20T17:11:00Z
Subject: Re: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners

Thanks for the heads-up. From NimbleRetail's side:

- Confirmed the pilot's retriever job increased batch size while we tested throughput. We can throttle client-side, but appreciate per-tenant caps — please proceed.
- Usage numbers look right; we'll provide a one-pager with expected ramp for May by Friday.

We didn't see a user-facing outage; the latency bump was visible in our monitoring but tolerable. If you need any logs from our side, happy to share.

Best,
Daria Petrov
Product Lead, Search & Relevance
NimbleRetail
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Daria Petrov <daria@nimble-retail.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: April sprint gate: KPI snapshot, QBR inputs, and owners

Thanks all — summary and next steps below (Irene/Jonas to confirm when changes are live):

- Latency (owner: irene_choi) — Revert rollout patch, re-enable KV TTLs 4/20 10:30 UTC. ETA: monitoring green by 4/21 EOD.
- Cost (owner: jonas_weber) — Per-tenant batch cap to 256 and alert on spend > forecast applied 4/20 14:10 UTC. Jonas: confirm throttling policy by Friday.
- Uptime (owner: irene_choi) — Patch for older instances scheduled; adding a short slide explaining auto-upgrade exclusion root cause.
- Usage/Pilot (owner: daria@nimble-retail.ai) — NimbleRetail will send forecast by Friday; we'll include pilot ramp slide in QBR.

Action tracker (brief):
- Tessa: consolidate slides and send to execs (Fri 09:00 PT) — DONE pending final confirmations.
- Irene: post-change monitoring check + write 1-line mitigation for QBR — ETA 4/21 EOD.
- Jonas: confirm throttling policy + capture cost delta in QBR template — ETA 4/23.
- Daria: pilot ramp forecast — ETA 4/23.

Please reply if anything is missing or if you want a different framing for the exec slide. I'll attach the final metrics snapshot and send the QBR packet Friday morning.

Tessa
Head of Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
